about: What quote matching folds text to (normalizeForMatch in src/discovery/quotes.ts). The bake-off's quote-survival metric (tools/asr) must fold the same way: both test suites read this file.

cases.why: hamza forms of alef fold to bare alef
Arabic question mark, comma and semicolon fold
zero-width and direction marks drop without breaking a run of spaces
Latin words keep their letters, lower-cased
presentation forms read as their letters (NFKC)
